preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() for c in camel_case(input_string) if camel_case(input_string).index(c) in [0] + [i+1 for i in range(len(camel_case(input_string))-1) if camel_case(input_string)[i] == camel_case(input_string)[i].lower()])
postconditions.description: Every word in the output starts with an uppercase letter, where a word is defined as a sequence of characters following a lowercase letter or the start of the string.

postconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in camel_case(input_string) if camel_case(input_string).index(c) not in [0] + [i+1 for i in range(len(camel_case(input_string))-1) if camel_case(input_string)[i] == camel_case(input_string)[i].lower()])
postconditions.description: All other characters in the output are lowercase.

postconditions.expression: camel_case(input_string).replace(' ', '') == ''.join(c if c != ' ' else '' for c in input_string)
postconditions.description: The output contains no spaces and is formed by concatenating all non-space characters from the input.

postconditions.expression: len(camel_case(input_string)) == sum(1 for c in input_string if c != ' ')
postconditions.description: The output length equals the number of non-space characters in the input.
